scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @todo/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @todo/web --filter @todo/api --parallel dev
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @todo/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @todo/api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @todo/shared typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @todo/web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @todo/e2e typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm --filter @todo/shared build && corepack pnpm --recursive --if-present test:unit
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm --filter @todo/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @todo/api test:integration
scripts.env:dev: corepack pnpm exec tsx scripts/environment.ts dev
scripts.env:test: corepack pnpm exec tsx scripts/environment.ts test
scripts.env:staging: corepack pnpm exec tsx scripts/environment.ts staging
scripts.env:prod: corepack pnpm exec tsx scripts/environment.ts prod
